title: WINDI Receipt
description: Canonical independently verifiable WINDI proof receipt. Version 1.0.0.

actor.description: DID or sovereign actor identifier. Example: did:windi:dragon-001

app.description: Originating WINDI module or system identifier. Example: windi-law

doc_type.description: Document classification. Example: contract, invoice, risk_assessment

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of canonicalized content. 64 hex characters.

hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used. v1.0.0 supports only SHA-256.

governance_level.description: Governance tier. HIGH requires human approval (I9).

verify_url.description: HTTPS URL to public verification endpoint for this specific receipt.

ledger_anchor_id.description: Identifier linking to Forensic Ledger entry.

human_approved.description: Indicates explicit human approval (I9 gate passage).

policy_decision.description: Policy engine decision. HOLD indicates pending human review.

invariants.description: WINDI Constitutional Invariants enforced by this receipt.

source_payload.description: Optional original internal payload for compatibility. Not part of canonical hash.
